name: fullstack-react-flask
notes: Strong fit driven by the aCount project: React, Flask, PostgreSQL and OAuth 2.0 are all explicit with real depth. TypeScript and GraphQL appear nowhere and must not be credited.
jd:
Full-Stack Engineer

You will own features end to end on a payments-adjacent product.

Requirements:
- React
- A Python web framework (Flask or Django)
- PostgreSQL
- REST API design
- OAuth / third-party API integration

Nice to have:
- TypeScript
- GraphQL
- Redis
